English Language.question: ১) Identify the correct complex form of the sentence below: I saw him at the time of playing.
English Language.option1: ক) I saw him at the time he had played
English Language.option2: খ) I saw him when he was playing.
English Language.option3: গ) He was seen playing.
English Language.option4: ঘ) He was seen and he played.
English Language.exp:
যদি কোন simple sentence-এ in the morning, in the evening, in the afternoon, at night, in the spring, in winter, in autumn ইত্যাদি থাকে, তাহলে tense অনুযায়ী উপরের phraseগুলোর পূর্বে when it is/when it was বসে + যে phraseটি দেওয়া থাকে সে phraseটি বসে।
তাই, প্রশ্নে উল্লেখিত বাক্যটির complex form হবে - I saw him when he was playing.

English Language.question: ২) Identify the correct complex form of the sentence below: Since the water was very hot, I could not drink it.
English Language.option1: ক) The water was very hot and I could not drink it.
English Language.option2: খ) The water was very hot yet I could not drink it.
English Language.option3: গ) Though the water was very hot, I could not drink it.
English Language.option4: ঘ) The water being very hot, I could not drink it.
English Language.exp:
Complex Sentence কে Simple Sentence এ রূপান্তরের নিয়মঃ
দুটি clause-এর subject ভিন্ন হলে এবং প্রথম clause টিতে am/is/are/was/were/has/have had থাকলে নিয়মটি দাঁড়ায়ঃ প্রথম clause-এর am/is/are/was/were-এর পরিবর্তে being বসে বা has/have/had-এর পরিবর্তে having বসে (তাছাড়া প্রথম clause-এর কোন পরিবর্তন হয় না)।
তাই এক্ষেত্রে সঠিক Simple form হবে - The water being very hot, I could not drink it.

প্রশ্নে ‘Identify the correct complex form of the sentence’ এর স্থলে ‘Identify the correct simple form of the sentence’ হওয়ার কথা ছিলো।
প্রশ্নে প্রদত্ত বাক্যটিই Complex sentence।
প্রশ্নে ভুল থাকায় উত্তর বাতিল করা হয়েছে।

English Language.question: ৩) ‘Linkers’ are often used in -
English Language.option2: খ) Essay
English Language.option3: গ) Paragraph
English Language.exp:
Linkers = Linkers are used in a paragraph.
Linker Words or Word Connectors are used to link large groups of words: phrases and sentences. We can also use them to connect paragraphs to give them coherence.
Ex: Whereas, Nevertheless, Despite, In Spite of, Instead, Alternatively etc.

English Language.option2: খ) Business English
English Language.option3: গ) British English

The term ‘CV’ is more common than ‘resume’ in British English.
On the other hand, resume is more common in American English.

English Language.question: ৬) Which one is not related to the Paragraph?
English Language.option2: খ) Terminator
English Language.option3: গ) Linkers
English Language.exp:
In these options, only Corrigendum is not related to paragraph.
Corrigendum = A thing to be corrected, typically an error in a printed book.

Linkers = Linkers are used in a paragraph.
Linker Words or Word Connectors are used to link large groups of words: phrases and sentences. We can also use them to connect paragraphs to give them coherence.
Ex: Whereas, Nevertheless, Despite, In Spite of, Instead, Alternatively etc.

Cohesion and coherence = also used in a paragraph.
Terminator = The last sentence of a paragraph is called Terminator.

English Language.question: ৯) “The Subscription” is an important part of -

English Language.option3: গ) Essay

1. Heading of the letter,
2. Salutation or Greetings,

Personal Letters এর ক্ষেত্রে - Your frind, Your son etc.
Formal Letters এর ক্ষেত্রে - Yours faithful, Faithfully yours etc.

English Language.question: ২৩) What is a descriptive paragraph?
English Language.option1: ক) Explaining a concept or idea
English Language.option2: খ) Give your opinion to the reader
English Language.option3: গ) Tell a story to the reader
English Language.option4: ঘ) Focused and detail-rich account of a specific topic
English Language.exp:
A descriptive paragraph is a focused and detail-rich account of a specific topic.
Paragraphs in this style often have a concrete focus—the sound of a waterfall, the stench of a skunk's spray—but can also convey something abstract, such as an emotion or a memory. Some descriptive paragraphs do both. These paragraphs help readers feel and sense the details that the writer wants to convey.

English Language.question: ২৪) What is the main purpose of the persuasive paragraph?
English Language.option1: ক) Inspire the reader to feel a certain way towards an event, character, place etc.
English Language.option2: খ) Explain a concept in full depth
English Language.option3: গ) Make the reader experience whatever narrated
English Language.exp: Persuasive Paragraph-এ কোন ঘটনা, চরিত্র বা স্থান সম্পর্কে পাঠকের মনে কোন বিশেষ অনুভূতি বা ধারণার সঞ্চার করা হয়।

English Language.option2: খ) Before the first sentence at the introduction
English Language.option3: গ) Never use this for paragraphs
English Language.option4: ঘ) After the topic sentence and before the closing sentence
English Language.exp: While writing a paragraph, we use supporting details after the topic sentence and before the closing sentence.

English Language.option3: গ) Therefore, as a result, consequently
English Language.option4: ঘ) Am, is, are, was, were

English Language.option3: গ) Paragraph Coherence

English Language.question: ৩০) Most paragraphs can function as ___

English Language.option3: গ) topic sentence

English Language.question: ৩১) Identify the correct interrogative form of the sentence below: 'You get hungry if you do not eat something.'
English Language.option1: ক) If you do not eat, do you get hungry?
English Language.option2: খ) Do you get hungry if you do not eat?
English Language.option3: গ) If you do not eat something, do you not get hungry?
English Language.option4: ঘ) If you do not eat something, do you get hungry?
English Language.exp:
Assertive বাক্য যদি হ্যাঁ-বোধক হয় তাহলে অধিকাংশ ক্ষেত্রেই তাকে interrogative করতে হলে তাকে একি সাথে negative -interrogative করতে হয়।
আমরা এই বাক্যটির Principal clause-কে negative-interrogative-এ পরিণত করেছি।
Source: Applied English Grammar and Composition by P. C. Das

English Language.question: ৩২) The correct Assertive form of ''How neatly my dad writes!'' is-
English Language.option2: খ) How neatly my dad writes.
English Language.option3: গ) My dad writes how neatly.
English Language.option4: ঘ) My dad writes very neatly.
English Language.exp:
Exclamatory Sentence-এ যদি adjective/adverb-এর আগে how/what থাকে তাহলে very/great বসাতে হয়।
এক্ষেত্রে how + Adv. + NP + Verb থেকে আমরা NP + verb + adverb structure-এ পরিণত হয়েছে।
Source: A Passage to the English Language by S. M. Zakir Hussain

English Language.question: ৩৩) Select the right positive structure of the sentence : “A plane flies faster than a bird”
English Language.option1: ক) A plane flies as fast as a bird.
English Language.option2: খ) A bird flies as fast as a plane.
English Language.option3: গ) A plane flies less faster than a bird.
English Language.option4: ঘ) A bird does not fly so fast as a plane.
English Language.exp:
than-যুক্ত comparative degree-কে positive degree-তে রূপান্তরের সময় নিচের নিয়মটি প্রয়োগ করতে হয়ঃ
প্রদত্ত sentence-এর than-এর পরের অংশ প্রথমে বসে। ii) Verb বসে + iii) মূল sentenceটি affirmative হলে not বসে; কিন্তু মূল sentence negative হলে not উঠে যায়। + iv) so বসে + v) Comparative degree-এর Positive form বসে। + vi) as + vii) প্রদত্ত sentence-এর প্রথম subject বসে।
Source: Chowdhury and Hussain

English Language.question: ৩৪) Identify the right assertive form of ''Who could ever help me like this?'
English Language.option1: ক) Who would never help me like this?
English Language.option2: খ) Nobody could ever help me like this.
English Language.option3: গ) Everybody could ever help me like this.
English Language.option4: ঘ) Anybody could ever help me like this.
English Language.exp: Who যুক্ত interrogative Sentence-কে Assertive Sentence করতে হলে who-এর পরিবর্তে nobody + বাক্যের বাকি অংশ বসে এবং Question mark-এর পরিবর্তে full-stop বসে।

English Language.question: ৩৫) Identify the right interrogative form of the sentence: It does not matter if we are late.
English Language.option1: ক) What though if we are late?
English Language.option2: খ) Why does it matter if we are late.
English Language.option3: গ) Does it not matter if we are late.
English Language.option4: ঘ) Does it matter if are we late?
English Language.exp: It does not matter-এর পরিবর্তে what though + পরের অংশ+ প্রশ্নবোধক চিহ্ন বসে।

English Language.question: ৩৬) Identify the correct Simple form of this sentence: Although He is wealthy, he is unhappy.
English Language.option1: ক) He is wealthy and he was unhappy.
English Language.option2: খ) In spite of his wealth, he is unhappy.
English Language.option3: গ) Even though he is wealthy, he is unhappy.
English Language.option4: ঘ) he is wealthy but he was unhappy.
English Language.exp: Though/Although-এর পরিবর্তে despite/in spite of বসে + উক্ত clause-এর subject he-এর possessive form his বসেছে+ Wealthy (Adj) এর Noun Form বসবে। প্রদত্ত sentence-এর বাকি অংশ বসেছে।

English Language.question: ৩৭) The correct simple form of “Work hard or you cannot finish the project.” is -
English Language.option1: ক) Without working hard, you cannot finish the project.
English Language.option2: খ) If you do not work hard, you cannot finish the project.
English Language.option3: গ) You do not work hard and you cannot finish the project.
English Language.option4: ঘ) Because you do not work hard, you cannot finish the project.
English Language.exp: Or যুক্ত compound sentence কে সিম্পল করতে গেলে প্রথমে without বসে + প্রথম বাক্যের মূল verb-এর সাথে ing যোগ করতে হয় + ক্রিয়ার পরের অংশ বসে+ or এর পরিবর্তে comma বসে + দ্বিতীয় বাক্য বসে।

English Language.question: ৩৮) Which one is a simple sentence?
English Language.option1: ক) I bought the car which was imported from Japan.
English Language.option2: খ) I bought the car imported from Japan.
English Language.option3: গ) The car which has been imported from Japan is working well.
English Language.option4: ঘ) The car was imported from Japan and I bought it.
English Language.exp:
Simple Sentence হল এমন একটি বাক্য যেখানে শুধু একটি মাত্র clause থাকে এবং একটিমাত্র subject ও predicate থাকে।
অপশন B-তে শুধু একটি clause আছে, I হল এর একটিমাত্র Subject এবং bought the car imported from Japan হল Predicate.

English Language.question: ৩৯) Which one is a complex sentence?
English Language.option1: ক) You know me to be straightforward.
English Language.option2: খ) You know that I am straightforward
English Language.option3: গ) I am straightforward and you know that.
English Language.option4: ঘ) I am straightforward yet you know that.
English Language.exp:
A complex sentence is a sentence with one independent clause and at least one dependent clause. It works best when you need to provide more information to explain or modify your sentence's main point.
আমরা দেখতে পাচ্ছি যে, অপশন B-তে You know একটি Independent Clause এবং that I am straightforward একটি Dependent clause। তাই, এটি Complex Sentence।

English Language.question: ৪০) Identify the correct positive form for this sentence: She is one of the most intelligent students in the class.
English Language.option1: ক) Very few students are so intelligent as she.
English Language.option2: খ) No other students are as intelligent as her.
English Language.option3: গ) Very few students are as intelligent as her.
English Language.option4: ঘ) It is true that she is one of the most intelligent girls.
English Language.exp: One of the যুক্ত Superlative degree -কে positive degree-তে রূপান্তর করতে হলে নিয়মটি হলঃ প্রথমে very few বসে + Superlative degree-এর পরের অংশ + verb-এর plural form +so+superlative degree-এর positive form + as প্রদত্ত sentence-এর Subject

English Language.question: ৪১) Identify the correct comparative form of this sentence: Akbar was the greatest of all kings in India.
English Language.option1: ক) Akbar is greater than other kings in India.
English Language.option2: খ) Akbar was greater than all other kings in India.
English Language.option3: গ) Akbar was not so great as other kings in India.
English Language.option4: ঘ) Akbar is a very great king
English Language.exp: Of all থাকলে সেক্ষেত্রে of all-এর জায়গায় than all other বসে এবং of any-এর পরিবর্তে than any other বসে।

English Language.question: ৪২) Identify the correct passive form: I wanted you singing a song.
English Language.option1: ক) I was wanted singing a song by me.
English Language.option2: খ) I wanted you who was singing a song.
English Language.option3: গ) I wanted you and you were singing a song.
English Language.option4: ঘ) You were wanted singing a song by me.
English Language.exp:
Subject + Verb + Object + Present participle যুক্ত Active Voice-কে passive Voice-এ পরিণত করতে হলে নিয়মটি হলঃ
objectটি Subject হয় + Tense ও Person অনুযায়ী Auxiliary verb বসে + মূল verb-এর past participle বসে + present participle যুক্ত অংশটি বসে + by বসে + Subjectটির objective form বসে।

English Language.question: ৪৩) Choose the correct passive form of this sentence: The beauty of the girl marveled him.
English Language.option1: ক) He was marveled by the beauty of the girl.
English Language.option2: খ) He was marveled at the beauty of the girl.
English Language.option3: গ) He was marveled with the beauty of the girl.
English Language.option4: ঘ) He was marveled about the beauty of the girl.
English Language.exp: অনেক ক্ষেত্রে Active থেকে passive করতে গেলে by ছাড়াও অন্যান্য preposition ব্যবহার করা হয়।

English Language.question: ৪৪) Choose the correct passive form of this sentence: I want him to write the letter.
English Language.option1: ক) I want the letter to be written.
English Language.option2: খ) The letter is wanted by him to write.
English Language.option3: গ) One’s letter need to be written.
English Language.exp: Subject-এর পর liking/loving/wanting/wishing etc. + object + infinitve যুক্ত Active Voice-কে Passive Voice-রূপান্তর করার নিয়ম প্রদত্ত active voice-এর subject + verb বসে + infinitve-এর পরের object (যদি থাকে) বসে + to be (passive infinitive) বসে + infinitive-এর পরের verb-এর past participle বসে।

English Language.question: ৪৫) Choose the correct passive form of this sentence: He made me do the work.
English Language.option1: ক) Doing the work by me was made by him.
English Language.option2: খ) I was made to do the work by him.
English Language.option3: গ) I was made doing the work.
English Language.option4: ঘ) I was made work by him.
English Language.exp: Need, bid, dare, make, hear, feel, let, know, behold, watch প্রভৃতি verbগুলোর পর Active Voice-এ to উহ্য থাকে। তবে passive করার সময় তাদের পরে to বসে।

English Language.question: ৪৬) Choose the correct passive form of this sentence: I gave him a phone.
English Language.option1: ক) I was given a phone by him.
English Language.option2: খ) He was given a phone by me.
English Language.option3: গ) A phone was given me by him.
English Language.option4: ঘ) A phone is given to him by me.
English Language.exp: Double Object যুক্ত Active Voice-কে passive voice-এ রূপান্তরের নিয়মঃ দুটি object-এর যে কোন একটিকে passive voice এর subject করতে হয় (তবে personal objectকে subject করায় শ্রেয় + প্রদত্ত মূল verb-এর past participle বসে + tense অনুযায়ী auxiliary verb বসে + প্রদত্ত বাকি objectটি বসে + by বসে + প্রদত্ত active voice-এর subjectটি object রূপে বসে।

English Language.question: ৪৭) Choose the correct passive form of this sentence: They searched his house and found a number of stolen articles.
English Language.option1: ক) His house was searched and a number of stolen articles were found.
English Language.option2: খ) A number of articles were found by the people becase they searched it.
English Language.option3: গ) His house was searched by the people who found a number of articles.
English Language.option4: ঘ) That a number of articles were found was by the people.
English Language.exp: Compound Sentence এবং Complex Sentence-এর ক্ষেত্রে Active voice-এর উভয় clause-কে একই voice-এ রূপান্তর করতে হয়।

English Language.question: ৪৮) Identify the correct active form of the sentence: The ship was burnt.
English Language.option1: ক) The ship was being burnt.
English Language.option2: খ) The ship had been burnt.
English Language.option3: গ) Fire had burnt the ship.
English Language.exp: Passive Voice-এ অনেক সময় object উহ্য থাকে। সেক্ষেত্রে Active-এ রূপান্তর করতে গেলে যথাযথ Subject বসাতে হয়।

English Language.question: ৪৯) Which one is a compound sentence?
English Language.option1: ক) Read more, without it you can not learn properly.
English Language.option2: খ) Read more to learn properly.
English Language.option3: গ) Without reading more, you will not learn properly.
English Language.option4: ঘ) Read more or you will not learn properly.
English Language.exp:
A compound sentence is a sentence that connects two independent clauses, typically with a coordinating conjunction like and or but.
They’re best for combining two or more self-sufficient and related sentences into a single, unified one.

English Language.question: ৫০) Choose the correct passive form of this sentence: The manager urged the supervisor to reduce the rates.
English Language.option1: ক) The manager urge the supervisor to be reduced
English Language.option2: খ) The manager urged and the rates reduced.
English Language.option3: গ) The supervisor was urged to reduce the rates
English Language.option4: ঘ) The rates were reduced by the manager.
English Language.exp:
Advise/beg/order/recommend/urge + indirect object + infinitve + direct object + যুক্ত Active voice কে passive voice-এ রূপান্তরের নিয়মঃ
indirect object-টি subject হয়। + tense অনুযায়ী auxiliary verb বসে + মূল verb-এর past participle বসে + infinitive থেকে শেষ পর্যন্ত বসে।
